info.name: Groupia Local — E2E
info.description: Workflow local A (creation et initiation), B (apres paiement manuel) ou N (negatifs). Variables de run a conserver. Aucun appel direct Bictorys ni webhook simule. Voir README.md.

exec: if(!["A","B","N"].includes(phase)) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error("runPhase doit valoir A, B ou N."); }
pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("baseUrl doit designer Groupia local, jamais Bictorys.");
try { document=pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Reponse JSON attendue : verifier le serveur Groupia."); }
pm.test("Aucun champ de secret interne dans la reponse",()=>pm.expect(found.length).to.eql(0));
if(found.length) {pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Champ sensible interne expose.");}
for(const name of ["phoneNumber","password"]) {if(!pm.environment.get(name)){pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Renseigner localement "+name+" dans Groupia Local.");}}

pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Scenario precedent conserve. Utiliser B/N, ou reprendre la requete exacte avec sa cle. Pour un nouvel achat volontaire seulement : newScenario=true.");
for(const name of ["phoneNumber","password"]) {if(!pm.environment.get(name)){pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Renseigner localement "+name+" dans Groupia Local.");}}
check("Inscription creee ou telephone deja inscrit",pm.response.code===201 || (pm.response.code===409 && r.code==="PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED"));

item.name: A | Creer produit et variante DEFAULT

exec: check("Checkout cree ou rejeu connu",pm.response.code===201 || (pm.response.code===200 && r.replayed===true));

if(pm.response.code===201){save("orderNumber",r.orderNumber);save("trackingToken",r.trackingToken);pm.environment.set("initialAmountDue",r.initialAmountDue);check("Commande PENDING_PAYMENT XOF montant positif",r.status==="PENDING_PAYMENT" && r.currency==="XOF" && r.initialAmountDue>0);}

save("paymentId",r.id);check("Paiement en attente sans anomalie",r.status==="PENDING" && !r.reconciliationRequired);check("Montant et devise attendus",r.expectedAmount===Number(pm.environment.get("initialAmountDue")) && r.currency==="XOF");save("checkoutUrl",r.checkoutUrl);check("Checkout HTTPS Bictorys",/^https:\/\/pay(\.test)?\.bictorys\.com\//.test(r.checkoutUrl));

item.name: A | Recu financier et pause manuelle

request.description: Fin PHASE A. Conserver les variables du Runner. Ouvrir checkoutUrl manuellement, payer sur Bictorys sandbox, puis runPhase=B. Aucun webhook simule.

exec: for(const name of ["phoneNumber","password"]) {if(!pm.environment.get(name)){pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Renseigner localement "+name+" dans Groupia Local.");}}
if(!pm.environment.get("trackingToken") || !pm.environment.get("paymentId")){pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Executer PHASE A puis conserver ses variables.");}
else {check("Commande CONFIRMED apres webhook (12 lectures maximum)",r.status==="CONFIRMED");}
for(const name of ["phoneNumber","password"]) {if(!pm.environment.get(name)){pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);throw new Error("Renseigner localement "+name+" dans Groupia Local.");}}
